_extractionNotes: Extracted directly from the uploaded HTML snapshots (Jun 2025 through June 2026); values are hardcoded exactly as found, converted from Indian lakh-formatted strings to plain integers.
Some source files reused an older 'Last update' date (a copy-paste artifact in the original HTML) — this is preserved as-is in 'lastUpdated' rather than corrected.

A few rows had truncated numbers in the source (e.g. '7,00,00', '7,19,00', '2027-04-00') — these are preserved literally where the intended value was ambiguous, or completed to the most plausible 3-digit grouping where noted below.
Oct 2025 and Feb 2026 Stock Portfolio sections showed two different figures (a highlighted 'value' line vs. a separate 'Total' line); the 'Total' line value was used as 'amount'.
Feb 2026 and Mar 2026 Credit Card Outstanding entries were denominated in QAR (not ₹) in the source; a 'currency' field was added to those list items to preserve that distinction.
Section 7 was titled 'Clair Loans' in Sep/Oct 2025 and 'Payments to Receive' from Dec 2025 onward — title kept as it appeared in each source file.
Jun 2025 had no Section 7 (loans/receivables) or Section 8 (credit card) — omitted for that snapshot.
'target' values reflect the numeric lakh/crore target stated in each section header at that point in time, regardless of the (sometimes inconsistent) target date text alongside it.
